headline: Last session: Sensex sheds 1,484 points amid heavy selling in banking and metal stocks; market closed today

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: BSE and NSE are closed today on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti.
Heavy selling in banking and metal stocks dragged the benchmark indices down in the last session.
Financial stocks faced profit-taking after a four-week rally in Indian shares.
Concerns over weak global cues contributed to pressure on the domestic market.
whatHappening: Indian stock exchanges are shut today for the holiday and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
In the previous trading session, the Sensex dropped 1,484 points and the Nifty fell below 25,400.
FIIs bought shares worth ₹5,672.99 crore, extending their buying streak to 16 consecutive sessions.
GSK Pharma announced the launch of Blenrep combination therapy for multiple myeloma, while Hyundai Motor India announced price hikes of up to ₹8,000 starting December.
summary:
Indian share markets are closed today, 24 November 2026, for Guru Nanak Jayanti and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
In the last trading session, the Sensex dropped 1,484 points as heavy profit-taking hit banking, financial, and metal stocks.
Despite the decline, Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net buyers, investing ₹5,672.99 crore to extend their buying streak to 16 sessions.
